events.description: Airport Transfer (Miscellaneous Matters) Act begins transfer of airports to airport authorities
events.quote:
This transfer began in 1992 with
the introduction of the Airport Transfer (Miscellaneous Matters) Act

events.description: HIAA designated as an airport authority
events.quote: HIAA was designated as a designated airport authority in 1999

events.description: HIAA signs ground lease with the Crown and assumes responsibility for Halifax Airport
events.quote:
on February 1, 2000 HIAA
signed a ground lease with Her Majesty the Queen in Right of Canada

events.description: Lynx becomes a signatory to the MOA
events.quote: became a signatory to the MOA on April 6, 2022

events.description: HIAA and Lynx enter the Air Carrier Operating Agreement amending the AIF remittance deadline
events.quote:
This was amended by the Air Carrier Operating Agreement (the 
“ACOA”) between HIAA and Lynx

events.description: Lynx stops remitting collected AIF to HIAA
events.quote:
Lynx had failed to remit collected AIF funds in accordance with its obligations
under the MOA since November 2023

events.description: Lynx pays $89,752.77, directed to aeronautical fees
events.quote: Due to a payment made by Lynx on January 19, 2024 of $89,752.77

events.description: Lynx files for CCAA protection owing HIAA $377,205.30 in unremitted AIF
events.quote:
HIAA was owed $377,205.30 ($328,004.60 + HST) in unremitted AIF
by Lynx at the time of Lynx’s CCAA filing

events.description: Lynx makes a single AIF payment of $601.65
events.quote:
save for one payment of $601.65 made by Lynx to the HIAA
on March 26, 2024

events.description: HIAA applies the $100,000 deposit to aeronautical fees and the residual $57,167.85 to AIF
events.quote:
After Lynx filed for CCAA protection, HIAA applied the Deposit to outstanding aeronautical fees
owed by Lynx to HIAA.
